page.overview:
Who is Ravna Abronsa?

Ravna Abronsa was a human female who served as a Jedi Master during the High Republic Era. She owned the droid ZZ-10 and was the Master of the Wookiee Arkoff. In 382 BBY, the three fought in the Battle of Dalna against the Path of the Open Hand.

Despite her age Ravna was still an incredibly powerful Jedi. Extremely agile, she could use Force Dash to move faster than her opponents could react and strike at incredible speed. Her fighting style consisted in waiting for the perfect opportunity to strike in order to defeat her opponent as quickly and efficently as possible. She was also able to sense disturbances in the Force.

Star Wars: The High Republic Character Encyclopedia
